newsitem.title: USA: Valero's Corpus Christi MTBE plant back up.
newsitem.headline: Valero's Corpus Christi MTBE plant back up.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp's south Texas MTBE plant has been brought back up following a 9-day maintenance to change a catalyst, a company spokesman said Thursday.
The Corpus Christi plant was brought back on line on Wednesday and is currently producing about 15,000 barrels per day, said Keith Booke, company investor relations vice president.
"We are currently producing 15,000 barrels per day and gradually we will be moving up to full production of 17,000 bpd," said Booke.
